svg.title: Relational Perimeter: endogenous operational decomposition
svg.desc: The computational layer connected to the four foundational Lean modules through the local import closure. One authoritative run constructs the measured entry, then recursively constructs a seeded root, extracts and filters candidates, opens two distinct alternatives, discovers a directed transport after failed decoys, compiles, validates and applies it, and transmits the retained output, next generation, decision history, provenance and seed to the next stage. Every executed reduction binds the generated opening, discovered absorption, materially computed output, criterion preservation, viable absorbed sibling and exact-tail raccord. The exact role history indexes a complete duplicate-free structural carrier of width two to the n. Every structural source has its own licensed reduction plan: left choices require the complete executed absorption reduction, right choices require a non-absorptive retention license, and sibling traces remain distinct. These plans cover one retained representative. The exact ablated operation grammar removes the left-absorption constructor while retaining right-side execution and the dependent-tail raccord; Lean proves that it cannot reduce a left source and therefore cannot cover the complete carrier by a singleton. A projected-state separator proves that stabilization witness availability and its coarse width readout do not factor through the permitted projection; a reference state shows that the projection is nonconstant. Failure constructs no descendant stage.
svg.text: The computational architecture formalized in Lean — one executed causal chain, not a readout reconstruction
The local import closure reaches the four foundational modules without an Alignment or persistence facade.
depth readout · exact old/fresh occurrence split
executeConstitutiveResolution constructs the measured entry; executeConstitutiveExecutionHistory recursively supplies the public history and its data.
next generation comes from the produced target
produced and stored in transmitted state
Each executed reduction binds generated opening, discovered absorption, computed output, criterion proof, viable sibling and exact tail.
retained: full causal witness · coarse readout some [1, 2, 1]
blocked: no witness · readout none · no projected view recovers the difference
reference: projection differs · the permitted projection is nonconstant
obligations indexed by the exact role history
left: absorb · right: retain · traces stay distinct
left crossing: absorption · right retention: no crossing
identities stay distinct · certified width 1 < 2ⁿ for n > 0
secondary numerical trace: 1 → 2 → 1 → 2 → … → 1 · length 2n + 1 · every width ≤ 2
no stage · code · next state · next root
The separation is decided during the computation, by the computation, from material the computation has produced.
